Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

result.description: The Trustee for R & C UNIT TRUST   Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter     Reports to : Project Manager / Site Manager   Direct Reports:  Carpenters / Apprentice / Construction Labourers / Trade Assistants       Position Summary   The Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter is responsible for carrying out hands-on formwork carpentry works while providing day-to-day supervision and guidance to small site crews on major energy infrastructure projects. The role involves constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems, interpreting engineering drawings, coordinating daily work activities and ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, quality standards and Work Health and Safety requirements.   Key Duties and Responsibilities   •    Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction plans for formwork and reinforced concrete structures.   •    Measure, cut, assemble, erect and dismantle timber, plywood and engineered formwork for footings, slabs, columns, walls, beams and other concrete structures.   •    Construct, install and maintain formwork systems in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Inspect completed formwork to ensure correct dimensions, alignment, bracing and structural integrity prior to concrete placement.   •    Carry out repairs, modifications and adjustments to formwork and temporary structures as required throughout the construction process.   •    Operate and maintain hand tools, power tools and construction equipment safely and efficiently.   •    Supervise and provide day-to-day guidance to a small team of carpenters and labourers, allocating tasks and monitoring work progress to ensure quality workmanship and timely project delivery.   •    Coordinate daily formwork activities with engineers, site supervisors, steel fixers, concreters and other trades to support efficient project outcomes.   •    Monitor the quality of completed carpentry works and rectify defects where required to ensure compliance with project specifications.   •    Assist with planning material requirements and ensure the safe handling, storage and use of construction materials on site.   •    Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area by identifying and reporting hazards and ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and company policies.   •    Complete works within project timeframes while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety and quality.   Skills, Experience and Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent overseas qualification), or a higher relevant qualification.   •    Demonstrated experience as a Formwork Carpenter.   •    Proven experience constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems for reinforced concrete structures.   •    Experience supervising or leading small site crews and coordinating daily construction activities.   •    Sound ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, construction plans and technical specifications.   •    Strong knowledge of formwork systems, construction methods, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Proficiency in the safe operation of hand tools, power tools and construction equipment.   •    Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe work practices.   •    Strong communication, leadership, teamwork and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.   •    Ability to work across multiple project locations, including FIFO/DIDO assignments, as required.   •    Current Construction Induction (White Card) and a valid driver's licence.  •    Additional industry licences or tickets (e.g. Working at Heights, Elevated Work Platform, Dogging, Rigging or First Aid) are advantageous.     About Company     About T&S Construct   T&S Construct is an Australian construction company specialising in formwork, concrete and structural construction services for major civil and energy infrastructure projects. The company delivers high-quality construction solutions across substations, transmission infrastructure, renewable energy developments and other large-scale projects, working collaboratively with principal contractors to achieve safe, efficient and compliant project outcomes.        Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-100000   Job Publish:  06-07-2026   Job Expire:  05-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5990066   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

Summary: 
Conduct research in the area of Neuro-Symbolic AI for reasoning and decision-making

The Opportunity
The School of Computer Science and Engineering has an opportunity for a two-year fixed term Postdoctoral Fellow in Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence. This Level A position is expected to conduct research in Neuro-Symbolic AI for reasoning and decision-making, contributing to UNSW’s research effort and developing expertise through defined projects.

This position offers the opportunity to advance your scholarly research and professional activities on both national and international levels. You will contribute to the writing of scientific papers and reports for international journals, participate in conferences and workshops, supervise HDR students, and actively collaborate with industry partners.

This role reports to Associate Professor Yang Song and has no direct reports. 

•	Salary, Level A - AUD$95,036 to $126,711 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full time
•	Fixed-term contract – 2 years (with the possibility of one-year extension) 
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school go to the following link - https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills and Experience
• PhD (or soon to be awarded) in computer science and artificial intelligence.
• Strong knowledge and research outputs in AI, particularly in the field of deep learning, knowledge representation and reasoning, or neuro-symbolic AI.
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
• Demonstrated ability to undertake high quality academic research and conduct independent research with limited supervision.
• Demonstrated track record of publications and conference presentations relative to opportunity.
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships.
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal skills.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate and interact with a diverse range of stakeholders and students.
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
Please click the “Apply Now” now button and submit your CV, Cover Letter and Responses to the Skills and Experience. You should systematically address the Skills and Experience listed within the position description in your application.

Apply now via JOBS@UNSW: https://external-careers.jobs.unsw.edu.au/cw/en/job/541257/postdoctoral-fellow-in-neurosymbolic-artificial-intelligence

Please note applications will not be accepted if sent to the contact listed below.

Contact:
For role-specific inquiries, please contact A/Prof Yang Song
E: yang.song1@unsw.edu.au 

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Eugene Aves (Talent Acquisition Partner)
E: eugene.aves@unsw.edu.au

Applications close: 11:55 pm (Sydney time) on Tuesday, 11 August 2026

As part of our recruitment process candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening, which may include reference checks, qualification verification, right-to-work verification, and criminal history screening where relevant to the role.

UNSW is committed to evolving a culture that embraces equity and supports a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can participate fairly, in a safe and respectful environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage applications from people of diverse gender, orientation, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander background, people with disability and those with caring and family responsibilities. UNSW provides workplace adjustments for people with disability, and access to flexible work options for eligible staff. The University reserves the right not to proceed with any appointment.

Step into a role where you can make a real impact and be part of an exceptional team of skilled Midwives and Obstetricians. At our organization, we are dedicated to creating meaningful and personalized birthing experiences for women in the private sector. You'll be part of a supportive and passionate team committed to delivering the highest standard of care.

This is an exciting opportunity to advance your career with access to leadership roles, education programs, and professional growth. Whether you're looking to grow your expertise or expand your leadership potential, we provide the resources and environment to help you thrive in your midwifery career.

A great work life balance with options to purchase additional leave

Our experienced team of clinical professionals, care givers and support staff are equipped to provide the highest level of therapeutic, medical and surgical services. We work together to ensure patient safety, well-being and recovery. We are a not for profit Catholic private hospital which operates across four sites at Fitzroy, East Melbourne, Kew and Werribee.

As an exceptional Birth Suite Midwife, you are dedicated to providing woman-centred care and utilizing your expertise to create positive, empowering birth experiences.

Your skills and experience include:

Recent hands-on experience in the birth suite.

Proficiency in FSEP and resuscitation skills.

Experience in a CTG Clinic or Antenatal Assessment (preferred).

result.description: Mega HVAC Pty Ltd  Our commitment to quality, innovation, and exceptional customer service has earned us a strong reputation within the industry. With modern manufacturing facilities in Oakleigh, Victoria, and a portfolio that includes major projects such as Footscray Hospital, the University of Melbourne, Chadstone Shopping Centre, and Melbourne Quarter, we continue to support Australia's growing construction sector with reliable, high-quality HVAC solutions.     As our business continues to expand, we are seeking a qualified Welder to join our skilled fabrication team and contribute to the delivery of premium HVAC products.      KEY TASKS    Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications to prepare and weld customised HVAC ductwork and sheet metal components in accordance with project requirements.  Determine appropriate welding techniques, materials, joint configurations, and fabrication sequences to ensure structural integrity, dimensional accuracy, and compliance with manufacturing specifications.  Perform MIG and TIG welding on galvanised steel, stainless steel, and other sheet metal materials used in the manufacture of rectangular, spiral, and oval HVAC duct systems.  Fabricate, assemble, and weld sheet metal ductwork, fittings, supports, frames, and associated HVAC components.  Set up, operate, and maintain welding equipment, hand tools, and fabrication machinery to achieve accurate welds while ensuring safe and efficient production.  Inspect weld preparations, fit-up, alignment, and completed welds to verify compliance with engineering drawings, quality standards, and Australian manufacturing requirements.  Finish welded assemblies by grinding, dressing, deburring, and polishing welds to achieve the required surface quality, dimensional tolerances, and presentation standards.  Collaborate with fabrication and production teams to resolve welding and fabrication issues, ensuring projects are completed efficiently and within scheduled production timelines.  Conduct routine quality inspections and identify defects or non-conformances, carrying out repairs or rework where necessary to maintain MEGA HVAC's high manufacturing standards.  Follow workplace health and safety (WHS) procedures and maintain a clean, organised work area.       REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE    A minimum of 3 years of full-time relevant experience in welding and metal fabrication, preferably within the HVAC or related industry.  At least an AQF Certificate III in Fabrication Trade, Welding, or a relevant trade qualification.  Proficiency in MIG and TIG welding techniques, with the ability to produce accurate, high-quality welds on sheet metal components.  Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication blueprints, and technical specifications.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality workmanship.  Well-developed problem-solving and troubleshooting skills  Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.  Effective communication and interpersonal skills.  Knowledge of relative safety standards and willingness to use protective clothing.  Fluent in English and Vietnamese.       NOTES   Available for face-to-face interview in Oakleigh, VIC 3166.  About Company     MEGA HVAC Pty Ltd is a leading Melbourne-based manufacturer and supplier of high-quality HVAC ductwork solutions, proudly servicing the Australian commercial and industrial sectors for over 28 years. We specialise in the custom fabrication of sheet metal ductwork, including rectangular, spiral, and oval duct systems, delivering precision-engineered solutions tailored to our clients' project requirements.
